passage.label: Commanded to worship Allah sincere and to be first of the Muslims; fear of a tremendous Day's punishment for disobedience; worship of Allah alone with the challenge to worship what they will besides Him; losers defined as those losing themselves and their families on Resurrection Day; canopies of fire above and below as threat, so fear Me; those avoiding Taghut and turning back receive good tidings; those listening to speech and following the best of it are guided and possess understanding; the one deserving the decree of punishment cannot be saved from the Fire; chambers above chambers with rivers beneath as an unfailing promise; rain made to flow as springs producing varied crops that yellow and become debris as reminder; the breast expanded to Islam upon a light contrasted with hearts hardened against remembrance, those in manifest error

arabicExcerpts.text: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي
فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ
لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٞ مَّبۡنِيَّةٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ

أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

mainSubject.label: The Prophet's commissioned sincerity and precedence in submission, with fear of the tremendous Day; exclusive worship asserted alongside the challenge to worship alternatives; loss defined as the forfeiture of self and family at resurrection; layered fire-canopies as the divine threat calling servants to taqwa; avoidance of Taghut and return to Allah earning glad tidings; the criterion of hearing speech and following its best as the mark of guidance and understanding; the impossibility of rescuing one under the punishment decree; elevated chambers with flowing rivers as an unfailing promise; the agricultural cycle from rain to withered debris as reminder for the understanding; the expanded breast resting on divine light set against hearts hardened to remembrance

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Say: I have been commanded to worship Allah, being sincere to Him in religion.
And I have been commanded to be the first of the Muslims.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: O My servants, then fear Me.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: So give good tidings to My servants.

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the patient-reward address (10) before the commissioned say-block opens (11); P2 ends at the expanded-breast/hardened-heart contrast (22); P3 runs from the best-statement description through the mutual-working challenge (23-40); P4 covers the Book-for-people declaration through the provision signs (41-52); P5 begins with the no-despair address and runs through judgement and the grouped drivings to the Throne close (53-75).
